reply.emotion: warm and bright, thinking of someone full of energy and life
notes: Joven works for both people and things, meaning youthful or recently created.
Do not confuse with pequeño, which refers to physical size rather than age.

senses.definition: Being in the early period of life; not old.

examples.text: Mis padres eran muy jóvenes cuando se casaron.
examples.translation: My parents were very young when they got married.
examples.emotion: fond and nostalgic, remembering a past time

senses.definition: Having been recently made or created; of recent origin.

examples.text: Es una empresa joven con muchas ideas.
examples.translation: It is a young company with many ideas.
examples.emotion: enthusiastic and optimistic about a fresh project

definitions: Being in the early period of life; not old.
Having been recently made or created; of recent origin.
